client_id.label: Twitch application Client ID
client_id.description: A public Client ID from your own Twitch Developer application. Do not paste a Client Secret.

client.title: Connect your Twitch account
client.description: Create a Twitch Developer application, copy its public Client ID, and paste it below. This provider uses Twitch's device-code flow and never asks for a Client Secret.

authorize.title: Authorize Twitch
authorize.description: Open Twitch with the button below and approve access to your followed channels. If Twitch asks for a code, enter `{0}`. This screen continues automatically when authorization is complete.

errors.auth_failed: Twitch authorization failed. Confirm that this is a valid Client ID for a Twitch application that supports the device-code flow, then try again.

manifest.description: Browse and play live Twitch channels followed by your account.
